text.title: Lionfish
text.menu_sub: Swim the warm reef and rest between corals.
text.menu_wild: Small fish swim near the reef.
text.night_hint: It's night. Rest still between corals.
text.intro: Up and Down to swim. Rest under a ledge in the day.
text.hungry: You're hungry. Look for small fish and shrimp near the corals.
text.no_food: Nothing to eat here. Look near the corals for small fish.
text.about_looks: Red-brown and white stripes cover its body. Its side fins open like fans and its back has long spines.
text.about_food: Eats small fish, shrimp and crabs.
text.about_home: Lives in warm reefs. In the day it sits still under a ledge between corals.
text.about_winter: Stays active all year. It rests and hunts in warm water.
text.about_young: Babies are born from tiny eggs in the water. They drift with the current.
text.about_fact: It hovers still in the water with its fins spread.
text.bite: A lionfish snapped at you! Swim for cover!
text.safe_tag: Tag, you got it! In Safe mode a lionfish never goes hungry.

year.shelter: In the day it sits still under a ledge. It rests between corals with fins spread.
year.young: Babies are born from tiny eggs in the water. They drift with the current and hatch fast.
